name: save-e2e-report-prose-and-hand-set
body: Two limits. (1) The test pins the coordinator's save report as exact prose — `Session saved: N change(s) in one commit` — so a reword of that line must update the assertion with it (task-11's `no pending changes` line is contract too). (2) The expected marked set is derived by hand from the mutation run rather than read back from the database's dirty rows: a widened or narrowed admission mark fails here without naming the offending DB row, and the direct row-level probes live in the phase-1 artefacts; upgrade by reading the dirty set from the held database if this test should diagnose the mark rather than merely detect it.
